Chapter 242: Chapter 4 Two Suns in the Sky, Revenge Will Not Wait Overnight (Please Subscribe)

With Lin Yuan’s current strength,

he could easily sense every little detail for hundreds or even thousands of miles away.

This was merely perception, but if he were to recklessly expand his Taiji Domain,

tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of miles would be within his control.

“Why have they come?”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

...

At this moment, about two hundred miles away from Cloud Mist Blessed Land,

two Escape Lights appeared.

They were Lin Yuan’s elder brother and second sister.

Over the years, his brother and sister would visit Lin Yuan every six months.

Now, it was not even two months since their last visit.

“It must be that something has happened in the Immortal Sect,”

Lin Yuan guessed in his heart.

Before long,

the two Escape Lights arrived outside the Cloud Mist Blessed Land.

Lin Yuan also promptly showed a hint of surprise and quickly opened the restrictive formation of the blessed land to welcome his brother and sister in.

Lin Yuan’s elder brother was named Jun Xiaoyao, with the Taoist name ‘Xiaoyao Zi.’

The second sister was Jun Zhilan, with the Taoist name ‘Zhi Lan Fairy’; however, other cultivators preferred to call Jun Zhilan ‘Shenxiao Fairy.’

“Little brother, the Sect Master has broken through to the Hollow Void Realm, and the Immortal Sect is holding a celebration; we are here to take you there,”

explained the elder brother, Jun Xiaoyao, immediately.

“Hollow Void Realm?”

Lin Yuan instantly understood.

The Immortal Path’s Void Refinement Realm is divided into three stages.

Entering Void Realm.

Hollow Void Realm.

Refine Void Realm.

The advance of the Taoist Immortal Sect Master into the Hollow Void Realm meant that his strength was considered powerful even among Ancient Saints, as most Ancient Saints of the past had their cultivation end at the ‘Entering Void’ Realm.

“Hehe, little brother, even grandpa mentioned you specifically; there’s no need to make this celebration widely known—it will be just some people from our Immortal Sect participating,”

Jun Zhilan, unlike Jun Xiaoyao, who was more formal, didn’t refer to her grandpa as the Sect Master when with family.

“Okay,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“But elder brother and second sister, I’ll first go to the treasury to select a gift for grandpa…”

Lin Yuan explained.

Even for close relatives, it wouldn’t do to come empty-handed.

“That’s fine,”

the elder brother and sister agreed, nodding their heads.

They watched as Lin Yuan left.

The brother and sister waited in place.

“Little brother has changed a lot over the years…”

the second sister, Jun Zhilan, said with a touch of emotion.

“The path of Body Cultivation requires enduring tremendous pain for advancement. How could little brother remain the same after cultivating to the Body Cultivation Golden Core Stage?”

Jun Xiaoyao, the elder brother, thought it was only to be expected.

Even he would feel scalp-numbing pain facing the breakthrough to the Golden Core Stage of Body Cultivation.

That Jun Wuji could have achieved what he has now, his mental state was already beyond other Golden Core Stage cultivators.

As for the huge changes in Jun Wuji, Jun Xiaoyao felt no surprise. Twenty years ago, after Jun Wuji was struck with defeat, he moved out from Mount Morality Immortal and came to Cloud Mist Blessed Land.

Shamed and then becoming braver, he embarked on the difficult path of Body Cultivation and achieving some success was no strange matter.

…

The treasury of Cloud Mist Blessed Land.

Lin Yuan walked in.

He casually selected a treasure.

To the leader of the Daode Immortal Sect, it didn’t matter what gift Lin Yuan brought; the sentiment was what truly counted.

“Condense.”

Lin Yuan stood still.

He retracted all traces related to Martial Tao and tucked them deep within his body.

Heading to the Daode Immortal Sect to meet the Sect Master who had entered the Hollow Void Realm, Lin Yuan naturally had to make thorough preparations.

“This should be about right.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Now, with all his aura retracted and even his physical strength temporarily downgraded to that of a Body Cultivation Golden Core Stage,

not even a Sect Master at the Hollow Void Realm, let alone a Refine Void cultivator at the Refine Void Period, could detect the slightest anomaly.

The reason Lin Yuan could so proficiently retract his aura

was firstly that he was also a Sixth Rank powerhouse, which was equivalent to the Refine Void Period,

and secondly, he had come from a Main World, having seen many Evolution Paths, making this task of concealing his strength seem like a dimension-reducing strike when compared to creatures of this World.

“It’s better to leave the Yin Spirit behind,”

Lin Yuan considered for a while, his thoughts stirring slightly as a faint phantom separated from his body, then disappeared within the treasury.

Although the presence of the Yin Spirit was almost non-existent, keeping it with him could still pose a risk.

Moreover,

leaving the Yin Spirit in Cloud Mist Blessed Land

was also a contingency plan prepared by Lin Yuan.

In case of any real emergencies,

having both the Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit out,

Lin Yuan would have more tactics at his disposal and wouldn’t truly ‘die.’

…

After all the preparations were made,

Lin Yuan, carrying the gift, came to where his brother and sister were.

“Let’s go.”

The second sister, Jun Zhilan, reached out her right hand.

A treasure of a colorful handkerchief with cloud patterns unfolded in the air, turning into a several hundred zhang auspicious cloud.

The elder brother and sister had come flying using Escape Light because it was the fastest method.

But naturally, they couldn’t return using Escape Light, especially with Lin Yuan beside them.

While a cultivator in the Body Cultivation Golden Core Stage indeed had the means to fly,

they could not match the speed of the elder brother and sister, both seasoned Nascent Soul Stage cultivators.

Therefore, the second sister activated the treasure to transport the three of them towards the Daode Immortal Sect.

“Come aboard.”

Jun Xiaoyao stepped onto the auspicious cloud treasure, and Lin Yuan followed suit.

After half a day,

the Daode Immortal Sect appeared within Lin Yuan’s sight.

There, above the sea of clouds, stood immortal mountains so tall they seemed to prop up the heavens, majestic and grand.

“Mount Morality Immortal…”

Lin Yuan gazed at the distant Immortal Mountain.

The Daode Immortal Sect was established atop Mount Morality Immortal,

which was the place where the largest spirit veins of the Central Divine Continent converged.

It was also a sacred land that all cultivators yearned for.

The Central Divine Continent had seventy-two blessed lands and one hundred and eight auspicious sites for cultivation,

all abundant with spiritual energy and incredible cultivation benefits.

But compared to Mount Morality Immortal… even if all seventy-two blessed lands and one hundred and eight auspicious sites were combined,
